import re
import sys


def main():
    text = sys.stdin.read()
    paragraphs = [p for p in text.split("\n\n") if p.strip()]
    paragraphs_count = len(paragraphs)
    sentences = []
    for p in paragraphs:
        sentences_in_para = re.split(r"[.!?]+", p)
        for sentence in sentences_in_para:
            stripped_sentence = sentence.strip()
            if not stripped_sentence:
                continue
            if stripped_sentence.lower() in ['mr', 'mrs', 'dr', 'st']:
                continue
            sentences.append(stripped_sentence)
    sentences_count = len(sentences)
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9'-]+", text)
    words_count = len(words)
    longest_word = max(words, key=len) if words else "-"
    print("paragraphs", paragraphs_count)
    print("sentences", sentences_count)
    print("words", words_count)
    print("longest", longest_word)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
